## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aec560807bc964835469e5062b5baa3dfe775a02`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0161-knowledge-platform-boundary-platform-owns-assembly-sync-split-record-return-knowledge-source-is-a-governed-type.md + none
Security-touching: yes

### ① Derived judgments

- PR #37263 (draft), `Part of #37097`, epic #37000. One file, +9 −0 against main: one `Amended` bullet at the end of ADR-0161's header list, and one dated note between K8's table and "What "capabilities" became". Three commits (`15616e2f`, `dd1756af`, `aec56080`); the third replaced the adapter sentence only.
- Owed tier by `record-recognisers --template --paths`: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, rules face, hits = the one file. No other file is in the diff, so `+ none`. The code the note describes is in PR #37256 and was read there at `6e978db363c73dc9d151549ef46d6c141bc679ac`, not reviewed here.
- K = 4 (merge-base `d62f9e9c05a4`, origin/main `7939732f3520`). None of the four commits touches `docs/adr/**`, `scripts/adr-anchors/**` or `scripts/adr-index.mjs`. `git merge-tree` against origin/main is clean (tree `228fc6e8b0ee`), and so is this head against #37256's head (tree `8ffb69713e46`). GitHub reads `mergeable_state: clean`.
- Check-runs at this head, read 2026-11-25T09:28Z: 25 success, 19 skipped, 0 failed, 0 running. `pnpm check:adr-anchors` and `pnpm check:adr-index` are steps of "Lint · repo & tooling gates", which is green; "Lint · docs & code guards", "Check Documentation Links", "Governed Surface Queue Guard", "PR-body guards" and "Test Core" are green. The cancelled Test Core shard belonged to the previous head `dd1756af` and was cancelled by this push.
- Generated files: `docs/adr/README.md` is byte-identical between this head and origin/main. The index reads the line that starts `**Status**:`; that line is not in the diff, and ADR-0161's row still reads "Proposed — 2026-11-24 …". No drift.
- The header bullet's link `#k8--the-contract-additions-decided-item-by-item` is the slug of the K8 heading and is already used twice elsewhere in the file.
- `check:adr-anchors` is a presence check over the entries in `scripts/adr-anchors/`. No entry names ADR-0161 today and the diff adds none, so the note cannot break it; CI agrees.
- Nothing was built or run locally. The first form of the recogniser call, `--paths` without `--template`, is refused by the script ("unrecognised argument"); the tier was read from `--template --paths`.

### ② Semver level

- Nothing publishes: one Markdown file under `docs/adr/`, no package, no schema, no generated reference. `skip-changeset` is the right label (AGENTS.md: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package).
- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. `Clause-②: yes` is the careful reading for a note on the contract's governing record and costs nothing here.

### ③ Boundary flags

Each declared deviation, at this head:

1. The adapter sentence. Withdrawn by the dev in round 2 (report `7158272523`). The sentence now reads, after the label "What an adapter stores.": "An adapter that stores `docHash` stores `organizationId` from the same version on; otherwise, once it starts reading this field, a complete reindex skips its documents and a walled search never ranks them." That is character for character the sentence in the TSDoc of `KnowledgeDocument.organizationId` in `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts` at #37256's head `6e978db3` (lines 60 to 63, rejoined). The pair is verbatim; neither side has to change. The earlier wording ("of the adapter", "a search filtered by organization") had the same meaning; see N1 and N2 for what the verbatim form costs.
